study type: Comparative case study with mixed methods, including realist evaluation components
exposure: National policies focused on improving financial access to caesarean and facility deliveries
cohort: Pregnant women in Benin, Burkina Faso, Mali, and Morocco
finding: National policies aimed at reducing financial barriers to obstetric care in Benin, Burkina Faso, Mali, and Morocco contributed to increased skilled birth attendance and caesarean sections, narrowed inequalities in access, and reduced financial burdens on households, without negatively impacting quality of care or untargeted services.
